remarks: Fantastic opportunity to rent in beautiful Darien! Enjoy top-rated schools, beach access, walk to train and the village of Rowayton. Charming 3 bedroom, 2 full bath Victorian home on a level lot. Refreshed and updated inside - 25 Raymond St is ready to go with a versatile walk up attic. Enjoy the outdoors on the lovely warp around front porch or the patio in the back. Partially fenced in backyard provides a great space for playing. The detached 2 car garage with Tesla charging station and additional parking is accessible by Raymond Height Rd. Occupancy can be immediate and can be rented through 6/2026. Pets are welcome.
